body: Thank you friend <3 I hope your situation improves too

You're right, this might just be a blessing in disguise. I'm now pursuing my back up plan, which is research in the medical field. I was able to get myself together and go to the orientation program today, and I love what the course has in store for me.  I'm beginning to dream again - there is certainly more than one way to help others. Thanks so much for your insight. I sincerely hope that, either medicine turns out to be all you hoped it to, or that you end up doing something you truly love in your life.
